I'm planning a new FSD feature in this React+Supabase ERP (MommaERP / codename Gidape). I need a precise map of conventions so I can scaffold a new feature called "ouvidoria" (anonymous ombudsman / whistleblower complaint channel for company owners — "donas"). Read-only investigation. Report with file paths and short real code excerpts:

1. The exact structure of a recent, well-formed feature under src/features/ (e.g. funcionarios, encomendas, or notas-fiscais): its index.ts barrel, ui/, model/ layout. Show how a *.page.tsx is exported in the barrel and how it's consumed elsewhere.

2. How routes are declared in src/app/router.tsx — show the pattern for ProtectedRoute + PermissionProtectedRoute with a specific permission, and the nested DashboardLayout/Outlet pattern. Quote 2-3 real route entries (especially any "master only" / admin-only route, e.g. funcionarios/analytics).

3. The permissions system: src/shared/hooks/usePermissions.tsx — what permission strings exist, how "master"/owner/admin-only is expressed. How do I gate a page to OWNERS only (the "donas")? Quote the relevant API surface (hasPermission, isMaster, isAdmin, roles, etc.) and any list of permission constants.

4. How the sidebar/menu adds entries (AppSidebar component) and the convention for menu categories (e.g. "DP/RH", "Sistema", "Gerência"). Show a real menu item definition with its permission gate and icon. Where would an owner-only "Ouvidoria" item naturally go.

5. The StoreContext API (src/shared/contexts/StoreContext.tsx) — how to read the active loja, and how a global/admin feature ignores per-store filtering.

Be thorough and quote real code with paths. Do NOT modify anything.
